name: DateRangePicker
summary: Combines two ISO date fields with a range calendar chooser.

useWhen: Choosing one contiguous start and end date, such as a trip or a stay
avoidWhen: A range shown inline instead of in a field; use RangeCalendar
Two dates that need not be contiguous or ordered; use two DatePickers

obligations: Expose start and end dates and the calendar trigger.
Keep the range calendar and focused dates keyboard accessible.

behavior: Controlled and uncontrolled values are supported; a null value keeps a controlled field empty, and clearing emits null.
A range is null or a complete pair of start and end YYYY-MM-DD strings; an object missing either endpoint throws a TypeError.
A range whose end is before its start is kept as given and is invalid.
A range whose start and end are the same date is valid.
Keyboard input preserves the native accessible interaction model.
Min/max date bounds are inclusive; controlled and default out-of-range values remain visible and invalid.
The unavailable-date callback receives the date being checked and the anchor, both as YYYY-MM-DD strings.
The anchor is the start date chosen so far, or null before a start is chosen.
Range selection stays contiguous, so a range cannot cross an unavailable date.
Open state is controlled with open and onOpenChange, or started with defaultOpen.
The date range and the open state are independent: controlling one does not control the other.
startName and endName each submit one endpoint as YYYY-MM-DD, or an empty string while the range is empty.
Built-in invalid presentation follows the owning Form validationBehavior; name-keyed external errors are exposed immediately.
Errors keyed by either endpoint name show together as one error message on the field.
Editing the range or resetting the form dismisses the external errors until the Form receives a new validationErrors object.
Resetting the form restores an uncontrolled range to its default value.
A controlled range is not changed by a reset, so the application restores it.
Interactive control sizes use the shared sm, md, and lg targets; md is the default.
errorMessage renders only while the field is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed native, custom, or server validation, and replaces the built-in message.
accessibility: Expose start and end dates and the calendar trigger.
Keep the range calendar and focused dates keyboard accessible.
